  - Job `build-doc` (name: 'Docs'):

      - `make -C Doc/ venv`
    - Build HTML documentation (step "Build HTML documentation"):
      - `set -Eeuo pipefail`

      - `make -C Doc/ PYTHON=../python SPHINXOPTS="--quiet --nitpicky --warning-file sphinx-warnings.txt" html`
    - Check warnings (step "Check warnings", only on pull_request):
      - `python Doc/tools/check-warnings.py \
          --annotate-diff "${branch_base}" "${branch_pr}" \
          --fail-if-regression \
          --fail-if-improved \

      - `./configure --with-pydebug`
    - Build CPython:
      - `make -j4`
    - Install build dependencies:
      - `make -C Doc/ PYTHON=../python venv`
    - Run documentation doctest (step "Run documentation doctest"):
      - `xvfb-run make -C Doc/ PYTHON=../python SPHINXERRORHANDLING="--fail-on-warning" doctest`
  - Job `check-epub` (name: 'Check EPUB'):

      - `make -C Doc/ venv`
      - `python -m pip install epubcheck`
    - Build EPUB documentation:
